title: Take off, hover, land
briefing: Take off and climb into the blue box, 2 m up. Stay inside it for 20 seconds. Then come down and land on the pad you started from.

rubric.label: Time inside the box
rubric.tip: Climb until the drone is inside the blue box, then let go of the right stick and only correct small drifts.

rubric.label: Keeping the height
rubric.tip: Watch the height while you hover: small, slow moves of the left stick.

rubric.label: Landing on the pad
rubric.tip: Stop above the pad first, then come straight down.

rubric.label: A soft landing
rubric.tip: Slow the descent in the last metre.

rubric.label: Smooth sticks
rubric.tip: Move the sticks slowly and a little at a time.
